newsitem.title: GREECE: FORECAST - Greek Aug inflation seen easing to 8.5pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Greek Aug inflation seen easing to 8.5pct.

text.p: Greek CPI inflation should ease to 8.5 percent year-on-year in August from 8.6 percent in July, bankers and economists predicted in an informal poll conducted by Reuters.
Fifteen bankers and economists participated in the poll which produced a mean forecast of 8.5 percent. Forecasts ranged from 8.6 percent to 8.4 percent.
the National Statistics Service said the official inflation figure would be released later this week. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
